questions.question: Which inspections does a system hold the record of, and on which date did each take place?
questions.sparql: SELECT ?inspection ?date WHERE { ?inspection a sampletankinspections:TankInspection ; sampletankinspections:recordedIn system:aps-planning-db ; sampletankinspections:inspectionDate ?date }

fail.breaks: an inspection recorded in something that is not a system

summary.meaning: One check of one storage tank's condition on one date. It is never a system itself.
summary.example: The check of a made-up tank on 2 November 2026, recorded in the APS planning database.

summary.meaning: The day the check took place.
The system that keeps the record of the check. It must be a system the ontology lists.
The rule for every inspection: it has exactly one date and is recorded in exactly one system of the ontology.
summary.example: An inspection with no date, or one recorded on a paper note, is refused.
